verses.text: Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ay jun winh winak skuchan Cis, yuninal winhaj Abiel, yixchikin winhaj Zeror. Ha winhaj Zeror chi' yuninal winhaj Becorat, yixchikin winhaj Afía. Niwan yelk'och winhaj Cis chi' t'a heb' anima.

Ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Saúl, te wach' sniwanil. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' israel, malaj junok wach' yilji t'a yichanh winhaj Saúl chi', te chaanh steel winh. Ha masanil heb' winak t'a Israel, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ay jun k'u ix satb'at juntzanh nok' sb'uru winhaj Cis chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yuninal chi': --Ak' lista a b'a, sb'at a sayan nok' b'uru chi', ik'b'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' et'ok, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'axpajb'at winh t'a skal lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix ek' winh t'a yol yik Salisa. Maj chaxlaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj winh. Ix ek'pax winh t'a yol smakb'en Saalim yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín, palta malaj nok'.
Axo ix k'och winh t'a yol smakb'en Zuf, ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi': --Konh meltzaj t'a tik, haxo ta tz'aji, swach' och winh in mam t'a ilk'olal kuuj t'a yichanh nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ha t'a yol jun chonhab' tik ay jun winh schekab' Dios, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a heb' anima, masanil tas syal winh, tz'elnhejk'ochi. B'at kila', ol yal winh tas b'eal ol kik'a', xchi winh.
--Konh an, anhej to malaj jab'ok tas skik'b'at t'a winh, malaj junok ixim pan ay t'a yol ko pa. Malaj jab'ok tas ol kak' t'a winh, ¿tas wal ol kik'b'ati? xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ay jab' tumin plata wet'nak, ol kak' k'een t'a winh schekab' Jehová chi', yik ol yal winh tas ol onh ajok, xchi winh.

(Ha t'a peka' chi', tato ay junok israel snib'ej sk'anb'ej yab' srazón t'a Dios syalan icha tik: B'at kil jun winh syal yilan chi', xchi heb'. Ha winh tz'alji schekab'ok Dios chi' tiknaik, ha t'a peka', a winh syal yilan junok tas ol ujok, sb'i winh yuj heb'.)
--Wach' jun, b'at kila', xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil b'aj ayek' winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ayik wan sk'e heb' winh t'a switzal chonhab' chi', ix schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak wan sb'at ik'oj ha', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a heb' ix icha tik: --¿Ay am ek' winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok? xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' ix: --Ayek' winh t'a eyichanhb'at chi', palta tato tze pil wal jab'okxo eyip olto ilchaj winh eyuuj. Toto wal sjawi winh t'a yol chonhab' tik yujto ay q'uinh ol och t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Anhej tzex k'ochi tze sayanek' winh t'a kal chonhab' chi', yakb'an manto b'at winh b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi' b'aj tanhwab'il yuj heb' anima. Masanto ol k'och winh, ichato chi' ol yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh silab', haxo swa winh yet' heb' anima awtab'il chi'. Yuj chi' ixikek wal tiknaik, k'okb'ilto ol eyil winh, xchi heb' ix.
Ix b'at heb' winh b'ian, haxo yik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', k'okb'il wal ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Samuel chi', wan sb'at winh t'a jun tzalan b'aj ol och ejmelal chi'.
K'ik'anokto sk'och winhaj Saúl, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi':

Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, swak'kot jun winh winak t'ayach, ha t'a yol yik Benjamín skot winh. Tzak'k'e akeite t'a sjolom winh, a winh ol och yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha winh ol kolan in chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo, yujto toxo ix kus in k'ol yuj b'aj ix tewi heb' t'ayin, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Saúl winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Haton winh tik wal t'ayach ewi, a winh ol och yajalilok in chonhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a spuertail chonhab' chi', ata' ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Al t'ayin mamin, b'ajtil ay spat winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok, xchi winh.
--Ha in toni. Konh wet'ok, b'ab'lajanh. Ol ach wa wet' b'aj wan in b'at chi'. Ato k'ik'an swal t'ayach tas a gana tza k'anb'ej chi', slajwi chi' tzach paxi.

Ha yuj nok' b'uru ix satb'at t'ayach yiktax oxji, manh ak' pensar yuj nok', toxo ix chax nok'. Palta ay jun mach te nib'ab'il yuj heb' ketchonhab' israel tik, a ach toni yet' heb' a k'ab' ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha in tik, yinhtilal in Benjamín, yelxo wal jaywannhej ko b'isul t'a kinhtilal chi' t'a skal masanil heb' ketisraelal. Anheja' heb' sk'ab' yok in mam chi', malaj kelk'och t'a skal heb' kinhtilal chi'. ¿Tas wal yuj tzal juntzanh tik t'ayin? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yet' winh schekab' yuj winhaj Samuel chi' t'a yol jun kuarto, ix ak'ji jun k'ojnub' te niwan yelk'och t'a heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh awtab'il wael chi', ay am junok 30 heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun winh ilum wael t'a kokina icha tik: --Ik'kot nok' chib'ej ix wal t'ayach to ch'ok tzik'kaneli, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' xub' winh, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha jun chib'ej tik ik'b'ilxokaneli, chi'a. Ha jun tik to naanxotax wuuj, ix in chek ik'jikaneli, ayik ix in chekan b'ojok jun q'uinh tik, xchi winh. Junnhej ix wa winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ayik ix emixta heb' winh ta', ix emul heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lolon winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat.

Axo ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix awtaj winhaj Saúl yuj winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Q'ueanh waan tzach b'ati, xchi winh. Ix k'e waan winh b'ian. Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' winh t'a yol kalle.

Axo ix emk'och heb' winh t'a titak chonhab', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Al t'a winh a chekab' tik to sb'ab'lajb'at winh, tzach kan jab'okxo, yujto ol wal tas ix schek Jehová wal t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix schekan b'ab'laj winh schekab' winhaj Saúl chi'.
